items.text: Adults 21 and over may possess up to 1 ounce of useable cannabis bought from a licensed retailer. Opening or using cannabis in public or in view of the public (parks, sidewalks, restaurants, federal land) is illegal; private use where the owner allows.

sources.title: Using and having cannabis
sources.authority: Washington State Liquor and Cannabis Board
sources.supports: possession limit and public use ban

psychoactive-substances.notes: State or provincial law. Read with the national rules (in the US, cannabis stays illegal federally: no federal land, no crossing state lines).
